tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: dregs 'dul nag po gnam lcags 'khor lo las: gtum po nā ga rak+sha'i sgrub yig snying byang dmar khrid bzhugs so: :

ྈྈྈྈྈ thugs dam gsang ba'i lha la 'dud:1$0000250 gsang sgrub rdo rje me 'bar gyi: sgrub yig snying byang dmar khrid bstan: gzhung ltar bskyed rim gsal btab nas: dzap khang dbye dus 1$0000300mdun bskyed ni: sku smad dbal sham can du bskyed: rlung ri mi shigs rgya gram mtshams: tsha grang 'khrugs pa'i e dbyings su: gnod byed sde brgyad mi ma yin: byad ma'i snying khar gzir zhing bsnun: bdag mdun gnas bzhi'i lha rnams kyi: thugs kar nyi steng rang mdog gi: khroṃ hrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐ mtha' ma ru: drag sngags spu gris gtams bzhin gsal: rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: 'od 'phros mdun bskyed thugs dam bskul: drag sngags 'brug sgra ltar sgrog pa: g.yas su 'khor las 'od zer 'phros: phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs rgyal ba rnams: drag gtum 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskul: zhing kun me 'bar kun nas g.yos: hūm̐ sgra thog chen bu yug 'tshubs: nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin mched: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad nas: 'jigs gzugs rngam sgra stobs ldan rnams: gnam lcags thog char ltar babs nas: mdun du bskyed pa la thim pas: de yang sku che yan lag rags: stong khams zil gnon ye shes 'bar: thugs srog rnams las 'od 'phros pas: bdag gi gnas bzhir thim pa yis: 'od 'bar gzi byin cher mched pas: yig 'bru'i rang bzhin rtsa khams khyab: rang sgras 'brug ltar me phung 'bar: ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas: rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa zhugs su 'phro: lus gdon thams cad gzhob tu btul: khrag 'thung bye bas go tshad gtams: lcags sdig bya khyung tshwa tshwa khol: bdag mdun 'od zer drwa ba yis: snod bcud 'byung khams ma lus pa: ye shes mthu stobs rdzogs par dmigs:1$0000250 rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bcu: le lo tshig bar ma chod par: dam par mtshams bcad bzlas pa'i rtags: 1$0000300rdo rje'i go gyon nyi zla shar: mchod rten brtsegs dang rdzong btsan bzung:

dung 'bud gter rnyed rol mo 'khrol: me tog 'thu dang phyag mtshan rnyed: chu bo rgal dang mkha' la 'phur: gru zam 'dzug dang mi mang 'dud: rgya mtsho rngubs dang ri bo 'phen: ri chen phan tshun zhabs 'og brdzis: nyi zla mtshon cha khong du mid: khyad par sgo gsum bde ba dang: rig rtsal phyogs med 'bar ba sogs: yi dam lha yis rjes bzung rtags: mon pa 'bag seng gar mkhan dang: rta drel ra lug gnag phyugs sogs: gyen du phyogs dang tshur la rgol: 'ja' tshon zug dang mtshon cha phog: thog ser rbab dang gzhan gyis ded: chus khyer mun gling 'khyams pa sogs: byad gdon 'tshe dang lhong ba'i rtags: thog mar cho 'phrul zang zing mang: ci ltar 'tshub cing rtags myur zab: bar du dbang 'dus bka' nyan rtags: mi mang khol dang gus 'dud sogs: cho 'phrul lha rtags ci byung yang: re dogs med pa'i ngang nas bzla: legs nyes rten 'brel so mtshams pa: rmi lam nyams su gang byung ba: snyems rtogs bral ba'i thog rdzis kyis: bcad gtub bsad gtor dmigs med gzhom: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ1$0000250 sgrub pa'i skabs su ting 'dzin gsar: 1$0000300sgrub rdzas nus sbar stobs bskyed de: 'od kyis srid gsum gdug pa btul: snod bcud 'byung ba'i bcud kun bsdus: zhing kun gcig tu rdzogs par dmigs:1$0000250 gsang sngags 'bum phrag gsum bzla 'o: 1$0000300sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈ1$0000250 las sbyor skabs su dgra bgegs gnyis: dgra 'dul lcog brdung gud du bkod: byad stems rbod gtong gshed dbab na: 1$0000300'od zer sprul pa'i pho nya yis: bsrung bya'i gur bcom bh+rūm̐ du gyur: yaṃ las rlung gis dmigs med gtor: don po'i tshe bsod yi dam lha: 'od zhu hūm̐ gyur bdag la thim: mgon med skyabs bral 'dar yed par: nad mtshon dug char bu yug gtibs: snying nang nṛ la spu gri bsnol: de las rtsibs ldan grangs med 'phros:

shugs drag 'khor bas srog rtsa gtubs: sha rus nang khrol dbang por bcas: lha dang dam can rnams kyis rol: rnam shes tshe bkrag bdag la bsdu: skabs su dgug gzhug thun char dbab: khroṃ hrīḥhūm̐ gi 1$0000250sngags sham du: 1$0000300byad stems pho mo'i snying la raṃ: rtsa la rbad: srog la breng: sha la myog: khrag la thun bh+yo: mā ra ya rbad nan:1$0000250 phas kyi rtags dang sbyar la bzla: rtags rdzogs bsreg mnan las mjug bsdu: de ni spyi ru bstan pa yin: 1$0000300bye brag sde brgyad rang gnad la: gshin rje mkhan dang nang 'gras na: snying khar ya nang nṛ yig gzhug: ya las 'od zer spu gri 'phros: rtsa bsregs gtubs sogs gong bzhin la: ya ma du: ya ma sad: ya ma nan: ya ma che ge mo aṃ gu sha dzaḥdza: mā ra ya rbad: ces btags bzlas shing ma mo la: ma ma ru lu du sogs 'gre: mu stegs mkhan la tirti ka du: gza' gdong mkhan la rak+mo du: lha rabs mkhan la dhe ba du: gnod sbyin mkhan la yak+sha du: rgyal po mkhan la rā dza du: lha btsan mkhan la rā tsa du: the'u rang mkhan la sā dhu du: rig 'dzin mkhan la rū tra du: phug bdag mkhan la ru tri du: sngags mjug gong dang 'gre bar sbyar: thun mthar sprul pa'i sde brgyad bskul: lus kyi gnas brgyad gshed chen bskor: des ni phas kyi byas pa bshig: 'byung ba bzlog par the tshom med: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa sde brgyad mi ma yin: sa bdag klu gnyan byad gdon la: bdag mdun 'khor lo'i 'od zer las: bya khyung phag sdig dug sbrul sogs: mtshon cha'i tshwa tshwa dpag med 'phros: phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi: 'jig rten srid pa mtha' nas sdud: gnod byed rnams kyi snying rtsa nang: lcags kyus bzung zhing spyi nas brdungs: de dag las kyang 'od zer gyis: sa chu me rlung 'byung ba'i khams: kun kyang rang gshed pho nyar gyur: drag ngar stobs dang ldan pa yis: byad gdon sa bdag klu gnyan dang:

sde brgyad mi min 'dre rgod sogs: hab hab tshir tshir bzung zhing 'cha': skad ngan tsir dir dgug gzhug bstim: srid pa khro chu khol ma bzhin: gnam lcags tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrug: gzhom gzhig bral ba'i ngang du blta: bsnyen pa'i sngags kyi sham bu ru: trig khroṃ ga ru ṇa gnod byed pho mo'i srog la rbad: khrag la rbad: rus la rbad: klad pa la rbad: rtsa rgyus la rbad: yid la rbad: trig khroṃ ga ru ṇa gnod byed pho mo'i tsit+ta zungs: tsit+ta rmugs: tsit+ta phyungs: tsit+ta rdzubs: tsit+ta myogs: tsit+ta thuṃ ri li la ya bh+yo: trig khroṃ ga ru ṇa gnod byed pho mo'i srog rtsa chod: snying rtsa phyungs: khaṃ khaṃ laṃ laṃ rbad: dum bur rbud: nā ga rā tsa gnod byed mā ra ya rbad sod: myog baṃ ril mā ra ya rbad sod: ces bzlas sbal sbrul glang dmar bsad: shing chen bcad dang nags me spar: rdzing brtol chu skam mkhar sgyel dang: rbab sgril brag gshog rol mo brdung: mgo snying sha khrag nang khrol spyod: bsad bcad rtags ni dpag med 'byung: khri phrag la sogs skabs dang sbyar: de ltar thul ba'i rtags rdzogs nas: bdag mdun gnyis med ngar bskyed la: chu srin kha nas 'brug stong ldir: dbal sham ngoms las mtshon tshogs dang: spu gri 'bar ba'i 'khor lo 'phros: gnod byed snying la gzir zhing bsreg: las dang rgyu rkyen drung nas phyung: srid pa spyi gnon dgongs pa nyid: ma yengs rtse gcig 'dzin phur gdab: sgrub pa'i sngags kyi sham bu ru: oṃ tsakra du na gnod byed pho mo'i mgo la chom chom: nā ga'i mgo la chom: zhe sdang sha la myogs: 'dod chags khrag la rbud: nga rgyal tsit+ta la gzer: dbang po yan lag zungs: nā ga'i yan lag zungs: 'grim 'grim: nā ga'i dbang po yan lag 'grim: rtsa thang rtsa thang: nā ga'i snying rtsa la thang: rtsa rgyus dbugs la thuṃ ril: nā ga'i dbugs la thuṃ ril: rtag byed rus la khruṃ khruṃ: nā ga'i rus la khruṃ:

'ching byed srog la rbad rbad: nā ga'i srog la rbad: rgyal byed srog la rbud rbud: nā ga'i srog la rbud: nā ga rā tsa sod sod: bying bying thib thib myogs myogs rbad rbad: nā ga rā tsa'i srog la thim thim: phob phob snying steng la phob: spu gri 'bar bas gnod byed pho mo'i snying drongs: nā ga rā tsa thuṃ ril dza: mā ra ya baṃ ril: mā ra ya rbad: khri phrag gcig bzla rū pa thun gyis brab: skabs su mchod bstod thugs dam gnad nas bskul: phur gdab tshe khrus gnas lung spyi bzhin bya: mtha' sdud hom bsreg thal ba zhabs su mnan: mdze nad can la byugs pa'i rdzas la bsngags: sdig srin byang nag sbrul sha gla rtsi dang: shug pa seng ldeng mar khu nyid du sbyar: ha sa ha sa ki li ha sa: sho tri pho phing: tsin tsad: ha sa ha sa ha hūm̐: sman chen nas 'bru phyed tsam la: brgya rtsa re bzlas longs spyod sbyin: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma: shin tu zab pa'i snying byang ste: dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i bu ma gtogs: ma 'chal dpe kha dam du chings: las can bu yi snying la brnag: bka' srung dam can thub par srungs: sa ma ya: gu h+ya: kha thaṃ: rgya rgya rgya: skyid grong thugs mchog rdo rje'i zab gter ro//
